about: The kernel calls the wall's seccomp filter lets through on Linux; every call not named here is answered EPERM. Each row: the call, its number on x86_64 and on aarch64 (null where the arch has no such call), the check the filter makes of its arguments where it is allowed only in part, the reason it is allowed, the interpreters on which the wall's own tests were recorded making it, and, where they were not, the written reason it is on the list all the same. A copy given to apply_wall in its place is named in the record as not the shipped list.

futex_operations.name: FUTEX_TRYLOCK_PI_PRIVATE
